links.title: Readings sources
links.description:
Link counters with sensors of other integrations to send their readings with the "Send readings of linked sensors" action or the "Send readings" button. Only integers are sent, the fractional part is dropped.

{preview}

no_counters.title: Readings sources
no_counters.description: Counters of this account are not loaded yet, so they can't be linked with sensors. Saved links are kept. Set up links once the integration is loaded.

error.duplicate_link: The counter is already linked to another source
error.missing_meter: Linked meter not found — replace or remove the link

update_value.name: Update counter value
update_value.description: Send counter readings, readings of one account are sent in one request.

values.name: Values
values.description: Readings of several counters. The new value must not be less than the previous one.

throws.name: Fail on error
throws.description: Fail the action if readings of any counter were not sent. When the action response is stored in a variable, errors are returned in the response.
